summary.title: How to Hire World-Class Engineers
summary.one_liner: A step-by-step guide to building an engineering hiring pipeline: employer branding, sourcing channels, relationship-first screening, practical on-site interviews, and fast closing.
keywords: how do i hire great engineers
takeaways: Treat hiring as marketing: build an employer brand (company story, blog, culture content) before sourcing.
Use four sourcing channels (hiring platforms, referrals, outbound prospecting, inbound marketing) and never stop sourcing.
Build relationships with engineers through short intro calls before formal technical screening.
Base on-site interviews on realistic, few-hour projects that mirror the actual work rather than algorithmic whiteboard tests.
Make offers quickly, discuss compensation openly, and treat culture fit carefully to avoid homogeneous teams.
summary.summary: The article, published by AngelList, walks through a six-part hiring funnel for engineers, based on a survey of 1,000+ startups and data from AngelList's A-List platform. It covers the current engineering job market, how to build an employer brand, four sourcing channels with their benefits and costs, a relationship-first screening approach, and practical interview design. It closes with advice on making quick offers and a discussion of how culture-fit hiring varies by company size. Examples from companies such as Wistia, CircleCI, Coinbase and Intercom are used throughout.
